changes: Ctrl All 0.2 (FLEXMODS v1.0, e6a2aab), imported unchanged: ctrlall.c. It hooks the one call of the stock lock setter (Track::setLock, 0x4002479a) and subscribes to ev_key, ev_enc, ev_tick and ev_draw; TRK+YES toggles it.

build.json is the author's mod.json: its site became an address, length and SHA-256 guard; the cflags name two firmware addresses (OS 1.54). The library builds the author's released ctrlall-0.2.elemod (sdk/imports/elekloader-ctrlall-2026-11-27.json).
transformations: None to the author's files. Stock bytes in mod.json's sites became SHA-256 guards in build.json.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata.
